hero.title2: The natural host for GPU and AI as-a-Service.
hero.subtitle: We implement a multi-tenant GPU and AI cloud in the operator's facility and operate the platform, with predictive operations for power and cooling.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: Telecom and data center operators are the natural host for GPU and AI as-a-Service. Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity and Intelligent Operations are primary fits; IoT & Edge is relevant; Blockchain is a limited fit. The typical first engagement is a GPUaaS / AIaaS build or a Predictive DC POC.

challenges.title: In-country GPU, sold as-a-service
challenges.body: Smaller organizations want to consume in-country GPU capacity and AI services by the hour or by the call, with no upfront investment.

challenges.title: Tenant isolation, proven
challenges.body: Without visibility inside the GPU, tenant separation and VRAM hygiene are assumed, not proven.

challenges.title: Power and cooling outages
challenges.body: Power chain (40–55%) and cooling (15–25%) cause most data center outages, and both show degradation days to weeks before failure.

challenges.title: NCA CCC
challenges.body: NCA CCC applies to cloud service providers and cloud consumers.

useCases.title: GPUaaS / AIaaS build
useCases.body: Operator business case and GPU sizing, platform implementation with the operator, then managed operations and revenue share on GPU-hours and AI services.

useCases.title: Predictive DC POC
useCases.body: A POC on existing BMS telemetry, then a subscription per site, MW or asset count.

useCases.title: GPU Compute Assessment
useCases.body: We deploy the agent, baseline the environment and show what is running, and what should not be.

useCases.title: AI apps on the operator marketplace
useCases.body: Hosted models, inference APIs and ready AI apps, such as the AI Call Center.

vision2030.body: In-country GPU capacity and AI services for SMEs and start-ups, mid-market enterprises, software and AI developers, and universities and research.

seo.title: Telecom & Data Center Operators | GPUaaS & Predictive DC
